preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 and 1 <= m <= 100 for n, m in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()[:2]])
preconditions.description: Input dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m and all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in row) for row in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Matrix w has n rows, each with m non-negative integers ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()))
postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' or a valid 'YES' block with k, a, and b arrays.
'YES' case must have exactly 4 lines: 'YES', k, a array, b array.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdout.splitlines()[2].split()))
postconditions.description: a array contains n non-negative integers ≤ 10^18.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdout.splitlines()[3].split()))
postconditions.description: b array contains m non-negative integers ≤ 10^18.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'YES') == any((k := int(stdout.splitlines()[1])) > max(max(int(x) for x in row) for row in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) and all((a := [int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[2].split()]) and (b := [int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[3].split()]) and all((w_ij := int(w.split()[j])) == ((a[i] + b[j]) % k) for i, row in enumerate([line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) for j, w in enumerate(row)) for k in range(1, max(max(int(x) for x in row) for row in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) + 2)))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', there exists k, a, b such that w[i][j] ≡ (a[i] + b[j]) mod k for all i, j, and k > all elements in w.
